$comment: The opaque copies of the logo PNG files that stand on transparency. Each is the transparent file flattened on one ground, with no clear space added: white for a variant made for a light ground, black for one made for a dark ground. tools/kleidos_brand/logo.py reads it.
why_color_is_black: The mark in color, alone or small, has no ground in its name. Its ring is 1.80:1 on white, under the 3:1 the rules of use ask of the color mark's ground, and the small mark in color is drawn for a dark ground; on black the ring and the body both hold, so its opaque copy is on black.
